summary: Iteration 12: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of OTP email verification, forgot/reset password, and regression on admin login + contact endpoint. All 8 backend pytest tests PASSED; all 3 UI E2E flows PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py verify-email: after MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS the endpoint returns 429 forever until user solicits a new code — expected behavior, but frontend does not currently surface a specific hint to click 'Reenviar'. Minor UX improvement.

auth.py login (line ~203): on failed login of unverified user, backend auto re-issues verification code respecting 60s cooldown. Note: this couples login and resend flows — a malicious user could probe verification status by triggering login. Consider always returning same 403 without side-effect timing differences. Non-blocking.

auth.py forgot-password returns 429 to non-registered emails? Not: it returns generic 200 for non-existent (good). But for existing email it returns 429 with detail — revealing the email exists via cooldown response. Minor info leak. Consider returning generic 200 on cooldown too.
reset-password sets email_verified=True even for previously unverified user — this is intentional (implicit verification via email code), documented but worth noting for auditability.
test_credentials: admin@onbuysolutions.com / OnBuy2026! (admin regression PASS). Test users created dynamically with qa-test-*@test.com and qa-ui-*@test.com then cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users created via /api/auth/register and deleted from db.users at teardown. No persistent data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend flow tests use mongosh/pymongo to read verification_code/reset_code directly from db.users. Resend cooldown is 60s — do not run cooldown tests twice back-to-back on same email. Real emails go via Resend (do not spam). Frontend testids used: auth-toggle-mode-btn, auth-name-input, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-terms-checkbox, auth-submit-btn, auth-otp-input, auth-verify-btn, auth-resend-btn, auth-forgot-link, auth-forgot-email-input, auth-forgot-submit-btn, auth-reset-code-input, auth-reset-password-input, auth-reset-submit-btn.
